title: Bank Reconciliation Statement (BRS)
intro:
भाग 1 — Accounting की नींव

कुल Problems: 4 │ 🟢 1 🟡 2 🟠 1

🎯 इस Chapter में आप सीखेंगे

Cash Book और Pass Book के अंतर को समझकर Reconciliation करना और Tally में Reconcile करना।

🧭 Tally में रास्ता (Steps)

Gateway → Banking → Reconciliation

Bank Date (Bank Statement की तारीख़) भरकर Reconcile करें

Unreconciled Items = Outstanding Cheques/Deposits समझें

⚠️ आम गलतियाँ

Issued-but-not-presented Cheque को Bank Balance में जोड़ देना (असल में घटता है)

Bank Charges/Interest की Entry Books में भूलना

📌 ज़रूरी नोट

GOT > Banking > Bank Reconciliation में हर Entry के आगे सही 'Bank Date' भरें; तभी Reconciliation सही दिखेगा। हर तारीख़ 1st/2nd/Last Date, FY है।

📘 Practice Problems

हर Problem में करना है: Pass the necessary adjustment entries in Tally Prime (via Bank Ledger) for the missing items, set the correct Bank Date for each entry in Bank Reconciliation, and match the two balances.
guide:
Bank Reconciliation Statement (BRS)

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

सबसे पहले — BRS का आसान तरीका

दो Balance हमेशा होते हैं

Cash Book (Company का Bank Ledger) और Pass Book (Bank Statement)।

फ़र्क दो कारणों से आता है: (1) Bank ने कुछ किया पर Books में Entry बाकी है; (2) हमने Entry की पर Bank ने अभी प्रोसेस नहीं किया।

तीन आसान नियम

  • Bank ने जो किया पर हमने Entry नहीं की (Charges, Interest, Direct Deposit, Dishonour) → Books में Entry करें; इससे Cash Book Balance बदलता है।
  • हमने जो किया पर Bank ने नहीं किया (Cheque Issued-Not Presented, Deposited-Not Credited) → Entry नहीं बदलती, Bank Date खाली रखें; ये BRS में दिखते हैं।
  • Adjusted Cash Book Balance, Pass Book Balance में दोनों Cheques का असर लगाने के बाद बराबर होना चाहिए।
मदCash Book पर असरPass Book से मिलान
Bank Charges (Bank ने काटे)घटाएँ (−)—
Interest (Bank ने जोड़ा)जोड़ें (+)—
Direct Deposit (ग्राहक ने सीधे जमा किया)जोड़ें (+)—
Cheque Dishonourघटाएँ (−)—
Cheque Issued, Not Presented—Pass Book = Adjusted + यह रकम
Cheque Deposited, Not Credited—Pass Book = Adjusted − यह रकम

Tally में Reconcile करने के Steps

  • छूटी Entries डालें: Bank Charges → Payment (F5); Interest/Direct Deposit → Receipt (F6); Cheque Dishonour → Payment (Account = Bank, Particulars = Party Dr)।
  • Gateway of Tally → Banking → Bank Reconciliation → Bank Ledger चुनें।
  • Bank Statement में जो Entries दिखती हैं, उनके सामने "Bank Date" भरें (Statement की तारीख़)।
  • जो Cheque Statement में नहीं है (Issued-Not Presented / Deposited-Not Credited), उसका Bank Date खाली छोड़ें।
  • नीचे "Balance as per Bank" और "Amount not reflected in Bank" देखकर मिलान करें।

problems.title: Basic BRS — Cash Book to Pass Book
problems.q:
🟢 Basic

  • As per Company's Bank Ledger (Cash Book), Balance as on 30th April = ₹ 50,000
  • Bank Charges debited by the Bank, not yet entered in the Books = ₹ 200
  • Interest credited by the Bank, not yet entered in the Books = ₹ 300
  • Cheques issued but not yet presented for payment = ₹ 8,000
  • Cheques deposited but not yet credited by the Bank = ₹ 5,000
problems.hint:
क्या करना है

Company के Books के Balance से Bank Statement का Balance निकालना।

  • Bank Charges ₹200 → Payment (Bank Charges Dr / Bank Cr)।
  • Interest ₹300 → Receipt (Bank Dr / Interest Received Cr)।
  • इन दोनों के बाद नीचे की Table बनाएँ।
problems.full:
विवरणरकम (₹)
Cash Book Balance (30 Apr)50,000
घटाएँ: Bank Charges (Entry नहीं हुई थी)-200
जोड़ें: Interest (Entry नहीं हुई थी)300
Adjusted Cash Book Balance50,100
जोड़ें: Cheque Issued, Not Presented8,000
घटाएँ: Cheque Deposited, Not Credited-5,000
Pass Book (Bank Statement) Balance53,100
✅ Check

Adjusted Company Balance = ₹50,100 ✔

Pass Book Balance = ₹53,100 ✔

problems.title: Reverse BRS — Pass Book से Cash Book
problems.q:
🟡 Intermediate

  • As per Bank Statement (Pass Book), Balance as on 31st May = ₹ 76,300
  • Cheques issued but not yet presented for payment = ₹ 9,000
  • Cheques deposited but not yet credited by the Bank = ₹ 6,000
  • Bank Charges debited by the Bank, not yet entered in the Books = ₹ 500
  • A Direct Deposit by a customer, not yet entered in the Books = ₹ 1,200
problems.hint:
क्या करना है

इस बार Bank Statement से शुरू करके Books का Balance निकालना।

  • Bank Charges ₹500 → Payment; Direct Deposit ₹1,200 → Receipt (Bank Dr / Customer Cr)।
  • Issued और Deposited Cheques की Entry नहीं बदलती; सिर्फ़ BRS में आते हैं।
problems.full:
विवरणरकम (₹)
Pass Book Balance (31 May)76,300
घटाएँ: Cheque Issued, Not Presented-9,000
जोड़ें: Cheque Deposited, Not Credited6,000
Adjusted Cash Book Balance73,300
जोड़ें: Bank Charges (अभी Books में नहीं)500
घटाएँ: Direct Deposit (अभी Books में नहीं)-1,200
Cash Book Balance — Entry से पहले72,600
Entry के बाद Book Balance (−500 + 1,200)73,300
✅ Check

Adjusted Cash Book Balance = ₹73,300 ✔

Entry से पहले Book Balance = ₹72,600 ✔

Entry के बाद Book Balance = ₹73,300 — दोनों Balance मिल गए ✔

problems.title: Multiple Reconciling Items — Both Directions
problems.q:
🟠 Advanced

  • As per Company's Bank Ledger, Balance as on 30th June = ₹ 1,20,000
  • Cheque of ₹ 6,000 deposited directly by a customer into the Bank, not yet entered in the Books
  • Bank Charges of ₹ 1,400 debited by the Bank, not yet entered in the Books
  • A Cheque for ₹ 8,500 issued to a Supplier is still outstanding (not presented)
  • A Cheque for ₹ 1,250 received from a Customer and deposited, was dishonoured by the Bank; entry not yet passed in the Books
  • Interest on Fixed Deposit ₹ 11,000 collected by the Bank directly, not yet entered in the Books
  • A Cheque for ₹ 3,500 deposited into the Bank is still not credited (in transit)
problems.hint:
क्या करना है

चार छूटी Entries Books में करना और दो Cheque-Items से Pass Book Balance निकालना।

  • Direct Deposit ₹6,000 → Receipt (Bank Dr / Customer Cr)।
  • Bank Charges ₹1,400 → Payment।
  • Cheque Dishonour ₹1,250 → Payment (Customer Dr / Bank Cr)।
  • FD Interest ₹11,000 → Receipt (Bank Dr / Interest Received Cr)।

जोड़ें: Direct Deposit6,000
घटाएँ: Bank Charges-1,400
घटाएँ: Dishonoured Cheque-1,250
जोड़ें: FD Interest11,000
Adjusted Company Balance1,34,350
घटाएँ: Cheque in Transit (Deposited, Not Credited)-3,500
जोड़ें: Cheque Issued, Not Presented8,500

✅ Check

Bank Statement Balance = ₹1,39,350 ✔

problems.title: Dishonoured Cheque और Bank Interest का BRS
problems.q:
🟡 Intermediate

  • Pass Book Balance (31st March) = ₹ 85,000
  • Cheques issued but not presented = ₹ 12,000
  • एक जमा किया Cheque ₹ 5,000 का Bank ने Dishonour कर Account में Debit किया; Books में Entry नहीं हुई
  • Bank ने Interest ₹ 700 Credit किया; Books में Entry नहीं हुई
problems.hint:
क्या करना है

Pass Book Balance से Books का Balance निकालना।

  • Dishonour ₹5,000 → Payment (Customer Dr / Bank Cr)।
  • Interest ₹700 → Receipt (Bank Dr / Interest Received Cr)।

घटाएँ: Interest (Books में Entry बाकी)-700

Entry के बाद (−5,000 + 700)73,000
